# Maps and objects with additional properties.
builder
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim any any
map m1 i in=m
map m2 i in=other
obj o1 a:s i n=O1
obj o2 b:i s n=O2
obj o3 {} any n=O3
umap um
props um - s
cls top m1:m1,m2:m2,o1:o1,o2:o2,o3:o3,um:um n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 3,4
print
unify 5,6
print
